data.body:
Plan posted (`planned`). Key finding: c11 has **two independent status surfaces** — the sidebar pills are driven by `Workspace.statusEntries` (`SidebarStatusEntry`, timestamped, written by `set-status`), while `SurfaceMetadataStore` (canonical keys, precedence tiers, `ts`, persistence, `derived` tier) drives the title-bar/manifest and `get_metadata`. `set-status <key> <value>` and `set-metadata --key status` are genuinely independent — this shapes the whole ticket.

Highlights:
- **TEL-1** last-updated infra already exists end-to-end and **already survives snapshot round-trip** (`SourceRecord.ts` → `PersistedMetadataSource.ts`, encode/decodeSources). Work = verify + test + modest UI exposure, not build.
- **TEL-2** decays the sidebar pills against `SidebarStatusEntry.timestamp` via a single coarse ~30s clock consumed **only by pill subviews** — keeps the `TabItemView` `Equatable` typing fast-path intact (the top risk). Tunable thresholds mirror the `NotificationFlashDurationSettings` pattern.
- **TEL-3** derives working/idle from the existing `PanelShellActivityState` shell-integration signal (+ AgentDetector 10s sweep) — **zero new hot-path work** — written to a new `derived`-tier `activity` key via the documented `MetadataDeriver` seam.
- **TEL-4** bridges derived→sidebar with a pure projector so an expired-explicit pill hands off to a visually-distinct derived pill.
- **TEL-6** the two-row cluster scaffold already exists on `origin/main`; only the "Waiting Agent" rename + paper-fill lit-state inversion remain.

Design chosen: **additive on the existing `@Published` flow, NOT store unification** (rejected on hot-path grounds; see §4 decisions D1–D5). Localization certain (6-locale pass). Full plan in `plans/task_01KWX7GBPYA1SGH3TR34BJHZCD.md`. Awaiting triple plan-review, then `awaiting-resume`.

⚠️ **Plan-review gate blocked (infra, orchestrator action needed).** The auto plan-review (triple) that fired on `in_planning → planned` **did not run**:

- Auto-review daemon (`.lattice/.daemon/auto-plan-review-task_01KWX7GBPYA1SGH3TR34BJHZCD.log`): `c11 new-pane --workspace DB29BC45 … failed: Error: Failed to write to socket`.
- Manual headless re-fire (`lattice plan-review C11-162 --mode triple`, `LATTICE_SPAWN_BACKEND=headless`): `c11 new-pane … failed (exit 1): pane_too_small: won't split pane:57 … below the 640×340pt minimum for a claude-code surface`.

Root: the review spawns its reviewer pane in the **orchestrator's workspace `DB29BC45` (pane:57)**, which is too small/crowded to split; the headless backend env did not redirect it off the pane spawn path. I did not force `--allow-undersized` or resize another delegator's workspace from the planning sandbox.

**Ask:** please re-fire the plan-review from a workspace with room (or with `--allow-undersized`), or point the review spawn at a roomier target. `review-status C11-162` is currently `none`. When findings arrive I will triage them into an authoritative amendment block on the plan. Meanwhile I'm moving to `awaiting-resume` per the boot; plan-validation will also run on RESUME regardless.

Plan revalidated against merged main (base = DX merge 16c9c2d2a). All plan anchors hold: SourceRecord.ts + MetadataSource.derived + PersistedMetadataSource.ts (TEL-1 infra intact & round-trips), Workspace.statusEntries/progress + SidebarStatusEntry/SidebarProgressState (TEL-2), PanelShellActivityState + SurfaceActivityTracker + AgentDetector 10s timer (TEL-3), WaitingAgentRow still 'Next Notification' with gold lit-fill (TEL-6 rename+inversion unbuilt), v2SurfaceGetMetadata at the extracted seam. C11-160/161 didn't touch TEL files — no drift. Proceeding to in_progress. Note: auto plan-review never ran (infra, flagged earlier); implementing against the revalidated plan.

Implementation landed on ts/tel-telemetry-truth (3 commits: impl+tests, docs/skill, localization). c11-logic build+tests GREEN — 1220 tests, 0 failures, all 5 new suites pass (ts round-trip, decay classifier, projector, deriver, workspace glue). TEL-8 metadata.md updated + sync-installed-skills run. Localization: 13 new keys × 6 locales. TEL-5 hot-path audit clean (hitTest/forceRefresh/TabItemView untouched; one coarse 30s clock; no main.sync added). NOTE: 'lattice code-review' saw an empty diff (it reads LATTICE_ROOT=parent checkout, which is on main; my commits are on the worktree branch) — running the boot-sanctioned own-reviewer fallback: two parallel reviewers (correctness/concurrency/hot-path + spec-conformance) on the real worktree diff. Next: triage findings → fix → tagged-build validation → push → pr_open.

## C11-162 · Telemetry truth — **pr_open** → operator merges

**PR #320** (base `main`, MERGEABLE): https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/320 · 5 commits on `ts/tel-telemetry-truth`.

### Delivered (TEL-1..8)
- **TEL-1** last-updated `ts` (persists across snapshot round-trip; exposed via `get_metadata --sources` + surface manifest age hint).
- **TEL-2** status/progress age decay (fresh/stale/expired; tunable 5m/15m + env overrides; one coarse 30s clock in child subviews only).
- **TEL-3/5** `SurfaceLivenessDeriver` → derived `working`/`idle` at the `derived` tier from the existing shell-activity signal + AgentDetector 10s sweep; **zero** new hot-path work.
- **TEL-4** pure `SidebarActivityProjector` single-pill takeover of expired explicit status; heartbeat re-report keeps a live agent fresh.
- **TEL-6** "Next Notification" → **"Waiting Agent"** rename + paper-fill lit-state inversion per the cluster plan (committed with the ticket).
- **TEL-8** `metadata.md` age/decay + derived-liveness docs; installed skill synced.
- Localization: 13 keys × 6 locales.

### Validation
- **c11-logic green: 1223 tests, 0 failures** (8 new behavioral suites incl. the two review-fix tests). *[validation artifact]*
- **Real-artifact smoke gate PASSED**: tagged `** BUILD SUCCEEDED **`, app launched (pid 60169), socket live, metadata round-trip confirmed on the running app. *[validation artifact]*
- **TEL-5 hot-path audit clean.** *[validation artifact]*
- **Code review**: `lattice code-review` saw an empty diff (reads the parent checkout, on `main`); ran the boot-sanctioned own-reviewer fallback — two lenses, both MAJORs (heartbeat freshness, progress persistence) + 6 minors resolved, suite re-green. *[review artifact]*
- **Felt/visual tier deferred to operator** (post-merge Human-use checkpoints): decay/takeover/cluster screenshots + live shell-emit derived-liveness could not be captured in this autonomous 6am run — the display was asleep (screencapture returned black) and no ncat/socat to inject the v1 signal. These are environment conditions, not code defects; the deriver logic + wiring are unit-proven, and `scripts/tel-scenarios.sh` + the `C11_SIDEBAR_STALE_SECONDS`/`_EXPIRE_SECONDS` recipe reproduce them on an awake display.

### Seam handling (C11-163 / EVT handoff)
1. **Derived-liveness emit (EVT-2):** the working↔idle transition point is `SurfaceLivenessDeriver.emitLivenessTransition(from:to:surfaceId:)` — EVT-2's call site. Left **unwired on purpose**: EVT (#318) is unmerged, so referencing `EventEmitter.emitDerivedLiveness` here would break `main`. The exact one-line wiring is documented at the site; connect it once #318 merges (mirror-and-flag per the orchestrator's fallback). Fires only on a real post-write transition (no phantom emit on a precedence-rejected write).
2. **Waiting-agent signal:** the TEL-6 restyle is rename + visuals only — the lit-state signal is still `notificationStore.unreadCount` (the notification unread edge). **No rewire** of EVT's `waiting.entered/left` emits is needed.

### Note
The board's auto plan-review never ran (infra: reviewer-pane spawn failed in the orchestrator workspace — flagged earlier). Implementation proceeded against the revalidated plan; the own-reviewer code review covered the diff.

**STOP — operator merges** (Wave 2 stops at `pr_open`).

Visual-validation retry (orchestrator technique): ran `caffeinate -u` and relaunched the tagged tel-post build (pid 35034, socket ready). The display lit momentarily (one full-frame capture succeeded, 12.3MB) but every subsequent screencapture returned a byte-identical all-black frame (156KB) — the macOS session is **locked**, and caffeinate wakes the display only to the lock screen, which screencapture cannot read. Per the standing instruction, standing down on visual capture: the deferral documentation holds. The felt/visual artifacts (TEL-2 decay states, TEL-4 takeover, TEL-6 cluster, TEL-7 recordings) remain for the operator's post-merge Human-use checkpoints on an unlocked session; the deriver logic + wiring are unit-proven (1223 green), the real-artifact smoke gate passed, and `scripts/tel-scenarios.sh` + the C11_SIDEBAR_STALE_SECONDS/_EXPIRE_SECONDS recipe reproduce them in seconds. Tagged app quit, caffeinate stopped. Ticket remains **pr_open** → operator merges.
